Last Tuesday, Leo and Sam went to the bird-watching spot. Sam's birthday is in February. Leo learned a lot about science. The sun rises in the east.
Leo spent the weekend at the zoo. Leo wrote about the day in the diary. It takes twenty minutes to get to the bird-watching spot by bike. Also, mum is frying eggs in the kitchen.
Life is full of small surprises. Sam is interested in cooking. Both of them like salad and water. In fact, everyone calls him by his nickname.
They took many photos at the green hill. Leo hopes to visit Paris one day. Leo likes windy days best.
